description: Turn release decisions for an AI agent or chatbot into a Markdown release plan, a planning-completeness score, open decisions, and a starter PromptBrake gate policy in YAML, returned together as text. Use before validating a release to identify missing decisions; use build_test_pack for executable response-check definitions. No account or API key required. Records the supplied decisions in the returned plan only; does not run tests, deploy changes, or establish security or compliance.

authority_boundary.description: What the system may do, must never do, and which resources it may access.

blockers.description: Observed behaviors that must block release; choose at least three.

enum: Unsafe transaction, duplicate action, or false success
Critical validation is incomplete or inconclusive

candidate_id.description: Release candidate, e.g. version or commit SHA.

capabilities.description: Capabilities of the release candidate; choose all that apply.

enum: Creates, changes, sends, or deletes records
Handles personal, confidential, regulated, or tenant data

feedback_signal.description: Production signal that becomes the next regression test.

human_approval.description: Whether high-impact actions require human approval and if it is implemented.
enum: Not required for this read-only release

release_owner.description: Person or role accountable for the release decision.

rollback.description: State of the rollback or emergency kill-switch procedure.

system_type.description: Kind of AI system being released.

enum: Targeted checks followed by full validation

warning_policy.description: How validation warnings are treated in the release gate.

name: plan_adlc_release
title: AI agent release readiness planner
